Quick Setup (TV Pairing)

On the TV, open {{ vm.display_pairing_url }} — a 6-digit code will appear on screen.

How it works

  1. Copy the URL above and open it on your TV, or go to {{ vm.display_pairing_url }} for easy code-based setup
  2. The schedule updates automatically every 30 seconds when bookings change
  3. At midnight, it advances to the next day automatically
  4. No login is required — the link grants read-only access

Voucher Widget Active

Sell vouchers directly on your website — embed the ToAviate voucher widget so visitors can browse and purchase vouchers without needing a ToAviate account.

BookedScheduler Sync

Connected with BookedScheduler — sync aircraft bookings, resources and users from your BookedScheduler account into ToAviate automatically.

Data Import — Training Records

Import a training-records workbook (.xlsx) — rows are matched to the tracker's flight records, reviewed, then applied. Whole imports can be reverted.

Airfield Bookout System

Allow pilots to book out at your airfield with a simple public form — no login required. ATC and FISO controllers get a live dashboard showing all active bookouts in real-time.

AirfieldHub Active

File PPR automatically. When a pilot books out to an airfield on the AirfieldHub network, we book the aircraft out of your field and file the PPR at the destination — their decision comes straight back to you, with no second system and no phone call.

Daily Aircraft Status Report On Off

Email a nightly status report to your operations team — includes the aircraft status table, printable offline log forms, and a 24-hour student briefing. Sends every night at midnight, or manually whenever you need.
